macro_cross_check.verdict: EXPLAINED, not a portion error. Carbs agree within 16% (15.1 vs 13), and carbs here come entirely from the crust - panko, parmesan, provolone, garlic powder - so the crust gram weights are right. The calorie gap is the MARINADE: 3 tbsp vegetable oil + 1/3 cup olive oil + 1/3 cup ranch = about 1341 cal source-basis, nearly all of it poured off before cooking. Excluding it gives 556 cal/serving, i.e. our purchased-grams figure brackets the source's 660 from both sides.
macro_cross_check.protein_note: I deliberately did NOT lower the chicken to match the published 35 g. Backing the crust's ~11 g/serving out of 35 leaves only ~24 g from chicken, i.e. ~108 g per breast - far under a 6 oz tray breast and under the estate's 167 g/serving average, and the source's own 660 cal cannot be reached at that weight. 170 g per breast is the honest each-weight; the published protein looks understated.
macro_cross_check.condition_flag: Carbs 15.1 g/serving clear the 35 g condition easily. Calories are the problem: my purchased-grams figure is 891 and even the source's own 660 is over the 650 ceiling, though the discarded marinade means real intake is nearer 556. The macro gate needs to decide whether discarded marinade counts before this one ships.
